rationale: After the two-entry repair recovered development silhouette 0.42795, align all four prototypes with current encoded-space density modes. Define explicit regions once, independently of all network assignments: digital has online_share>0.6 (a near-empty 0.5-0.7 gap); premium has online_share<=0.6 and basket>90 USD; the remaining store customers are frequent if spend>=2500 USD, otherwise budget. The offline low-basket spend histogram has a low-density valley at 2000-2500 USD between the roughly 1400 and 4000 USD modes, and the high-spend side has mean recency 3.53 days versus 10.46 days below 2500. Take one arithmetic mean of standardized behavioral features inside each fixed region; there are 314,290,210,146 rows. Use exactly W_k=2*c_k and b_k=-||c_k||^2 to implement Euclidean nearest-prototype assignments. Set age coordinates to zero because age is uncorrelated with behavior and has nearly equal regional means; missing flags are zero throughout support. This removes residual mismatches in the original prototypes and biases, including a positive online-share coordinate in the premium prototype despite that region being below the overall online-share mean. No optimizer, centroid reassignment, repeated means, or parameter search; a single summary of human-specified density regions.
